# pai identity

Say who you are, so mail to you can be told from mail to others

```
pai identity <command>
```

Say who you are, so mail to you can be told from mail to others.

```sh
pai identity show
pai identity add me@example.com
```

### pai identity show

Show your addresses and where mail is delivered

```
pai identity show
```

Show your addresses and where mail is delivered.

```sh
pai identity show
pai identity show
```

See also: `pai identity add`

### pai identity add

Add an address that is yours

```
pai identity add EMAIL
```

Add an address that is yours.

Declare an address as your own (widens what can be sent unreviewed)

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `EMAIL` | yes | Email address |

```sh
pai identity add me@example.com
pai identity show
```

See also: `pai identity remove`, `pai identity show`

### pai identity remove

Stop treating an address as yours

```
pai identity remove EMAIL
```

Stop treating an address as yours.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `EMAIL` | yes | Email address |

```sh
pai identity remove me@example.com
pai identity show
```

See also: `pai identity set-delivery`, `pai identity add`

### pai identity set-delivery

Choose where digests and "mail me" messages go

```
pai identity set-delivery EMAIL
```

Choose where digests and "mail me" messages go.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `EMAIL` | yes | Email address |

```sh
pai identity set-delivery me@example.com
pai identity show
```

See also: `pai identity remove`
